Name: Transaction Cost (Per Trade)
Description: Estimated friction per trade (Slippage + Commissions) to realistic PnL. E.g. $4 comm + $12.50 slip = 16.5

Name: Buy Lookback
Description: Donchian lookback in bars (used when Buy Lookback (minutes) row absent; else derived)

Name: Sell Lookback
Description: Donchian lookback in bars (used when Sell Lookback (minutes) row absent; else derived)

Name: Buy Lookback (minutes)
Description: Wall-clock lookback for longs; effective bars = minutes / Timeframe (minutes) when this row exists

Name: Sell Lookback (minutes)
Description: Wall-clock lookback for shorts; effective bars = minutes / Timeframe (minutes) when this row exists

Name: RSI Max Buy Threshold
Description: RSI must be below this to buy (exhaustion)

Name: RSI Min Sell Threshold
Description: RSI must be above this to sell

Name: Enable RTH Filter
Description: Restrict entries to RTH only (0=false, 1=true) - OPTIMIZABLE

Name: RTH Exit Buffer (minutes)
Description: Minutes before RTH end to start closing positions (0 = no auto-close)

Name: Daily Maintenance Start (HH:MM)
Description: Daily maintenance period start in Eastern Time (ES: 4:00 PM CT = 5:00 PM ET)

Name: Daily Maintenance End (HH:MM)
Description: Daily maintenance period end in Eastern Time (ES: 4:30 PM CT = 5:30 PM ET)

Name: Weekend Maintenance Start Day
Description: Weekend maintenance start day (0=Monday, 1=Tuesday, 2=Wednesday, 3=Thursday, 4=Friday, 5=Saturday, 6=Sunday). For ES futures: 4 (Friday)

Name: Weekend Maintenance Start Time (HH:MM)
Description: Weekend maintenance start time in Eastern Time (ES: Fri 4:00 PM CT = 5:00 PM ET)

Name: Weekend Maintenance End Day
Description: Weekend maintenance end day (0=Monday, 1=Tuesday, 2=Wednesday, 3=Thursday, 4=Friday, 5=Saturday, 6=Sunday). For ES futures: 6 (Sunday)

Name: Weekend Maintenance End Time (HH:MM)
Description: Weekend maintenance end time in Eastern Time (ES: Sun 5:00 PM CT = 6:00 PM ET)

Name: Maintenance Buffer Minutes
Description: Minutes before/after maintenance to exit/block trading

Name: USE_INTERLEAVED_SPLIT
Description: Use interleaved IS/OOS periods instead of single split

Name: MIN_PROFIT_PER_TRADE
Description: Hard Limit: Minimum accepted Profit Per Trade margin strictly enforced under slippage penalty

Name: NORM_DD_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Max Drawdown in dollars

Name: NORM_PNL_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Total Profit in dollars

Name: NORM_PROFIT_TRADE_MAX
Description: Normalization range for Avg Profit Per Trade

Name: MIN_WIN_RATE
Description: Minimum win rate threshold (trend following is often lower WR)

Name: MIN_TRADE_DURATION
Description: Hard Limit: Min avg minutes per trade

Name: MAX_WIN_RATE_CAP
Description: Hard Limit: Max win rate before penalty

Name: LIMIT_MAX_LOSS
Description: Hard Limit: Severe loss penalty threshold

Name: LIMIT_MIN_SORTINO
Description: Hard Limit: Severe Sortino penalty threshold

Name: ENABLE_FILTER_STACK_TRADE_PENALTY
Description: When 1: soften fitness if many entry/session filters are on but trades/day stay below a rising floor (interaction penalty)

Name: INTERACTION_PENALTY_STRENGTH
Description: Scale 0-1 for filter-stack vs low-trade interaction penalty

Name: INTERACTION_LOW_TRADES_BASE
Description: Base trades/day expected before per-filter increment (interaction penalty)

Name: INTERACTION_LOW_TRADES_PER_FILTER
Description: Added to expected min trades/day per enabled stack filter

Name: INTERACTION_MIN_FILTERS
Description: Minimum enabled stack filters before interaction penalty applies
